items.ex: To avoid something means to stay away from it, or to stop it from happening. The core idea is keeping your distance from something you don't want. We use it two ways. Avoid plus a noun: avoid traffic, avoid mistakes, avoid sugar. Or avoid plus an i n g verb: avoid talking, avoid eating late. One important rule. After avoid, we never use "to". Don't say "avoid to eat". Say "avoid eating". It works for people too. If you avoid someone, you try not to see them or talk to them.
exs: Please avoid rubbing your eyes for the first twenty-four hours after your lash appointment.
I try to avoid coffee after three p.m., or I can't sleep.
She's been avoiding me all week. I think she's upset.
